summary: Frontend-only regression + new-feature UI test of Pro Photo Sorter iteration 2 (Playwright, 1920x1080, public preview URL). Verified: clean load with 0 console errors (after 1 fix), toolbar with COPY/MOVE chip + Edit/Categories/Batch/Settings/Shortcuts, full Settings modal (Store Mode, Filename Template with 5 presets + input + live preview, 6 star-filter buttons, thumbnail cache clear + toast), Copy<->Move round trip with mode-indicator update, template preset -> input + preview correctness, star filter >=3 save without crash, Shortcuts modal containing E / 1-5 / 0 entries, Edit button disabled (disabled attr + opacity 0.4), pps.state.v2 persistence verified across a full page reload (iteration-1 flush issue no longer reproducible), and default Subject/Rating categories still present. 18/19 checks passed.

ui_bugs.issue: Cancel does not discard local edits. The modal is always mounted in App.js (<SettingsModal open={showSettings} .../>) while `const [local, setLocal] = useState(settings)` initializes only once, so unsaved changes survive Cancel. Reproduced: open Settings -> click Move + 'Studio format' preset -> Cancel -> reopen: input still shows '{date}-{folder}-{labels}{ext}' and Move is highlighted, while the persisted state is Copy/default template. UI now misrepresents actual settings. Fix: reset local from settings when `open` flips true (useEffect on open) or only render the modal when open.

action_items: SettingsModal: sync `local` state with `settings` on open (useEffect) or conditionally mount the modal, so Cancel truly discards unsaved edits.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 880 lines (>700) - split toolbar, filmstrip, modals and keyboard-shortcut handling into separate modules.
CategoryManager BUILTIN_ICONS had 'Snowflake' listed twice, producing a React duplicate-key console error whenever the icon grid rendered (fixed by me).
SettingsModal derives all UI from a one-time useState copy of props while permanently mounted - a prop-sync anti-pattern (see ui_bugs).

ImageEditor.jsx (513 lines) and the actual move/copy/save-file paths could not be exercised because the File System Access directory picker cannot be automated; it compiles and imports cleanly with no runtime errors on load.
seed_data_creation: None. Settings toggled during test were reset to defaults (Copy, default template, star filter All).
context_for_next_testing_agent: localStorage key pps.state.v2 confirmed working; settings survive reload (iteration-1 flush bug fixed). Preset testids: preset-default-(folder-/-labels), preset-date-first, preset-star-culling, preset-studio-format, preset-original-preserved. Star filter testids: star-filter-0..5. Remaining untestable area: File System Access API flows (source/dest picker, filmstrip with real images, star rating overlay on a loaded image, ImageEditor zoom/pan/crop/sharpen/save). Only open bug: SettingsModal stale local state after Cancel.
rca_of_the_issue: SettingsModal is rendered unconditionally by App.js and returns null internally when closed, so React never unmounts it; useState(settings) therefore captures props only at first mount and is never re-synced, leaving discarded Cancel edits visible on reopen.
